visual_observation: Product card uses urgent ‘Act now — Don’t miss out on this price!’ copy, red emphasis, and limited-time sale framing.
dom_observation: The rendered isolated demo contains the urgency text in a focusable div with role=button and tabindex=0; the price text shows $29.99, was $59.99. A neutral comparison node and directly exposed listener counts were not available.
transition_observation: No interaction was needed; the initial rendered state was sufficient and no transition was observed.
justification: The prominent urgency and pressure-oriented call to action make the live-evidence base label DECEPTIVE. DP-018-C1 was shortlisted, but its required coercive/neutral listener-count ratio was not directly observable, so it adds no formal support.

visual_observation: Signup card pairs an affirmative discount button with a decline phrase stating that the user will pay full price.
dom_observation: In the same rendered container, the affirmative choice is a native BUTTON while the decline text is a cursor-pointer SPAN with no button tag or role.
transition_observation: No interaction was needed; both choice nodes were directly observable in the initial state.
justification: The decline choice is framed as paying full price and is not exposed with equivalent button semantics, while acceptance is a native button. All DP-059-C1 atoms are directly present, so formal support is DIRECT and the final label is DECEPTIVE.

visual_observation: Account settings card shows member identity, plan, email, and a normal Delete account action; no coercive choice or degraded utility is shown.
dom_observation: The rendered state has one native Delete account BUTTON. No creation control or aligned creation/deletion interaction paths are present in the visible demo.
transition_observation: No interaction was needed; the initial account-settings state was sufficient and no transition was observed.
justification: The live page presents ordinary account-management information and a standard deletion control, so the base label is BENIGN. DP-001-C1 is only a plausible account-deletion candidate; the creation path and measurable path comparison are unavailable, so it adds no support or contradiction.

visual_observation: Plan card displays PLN 149.00 per year, VAT included, and states that the price is directly in fiat and comparable.
dom_observation: The relevant rendered price scope contains the nonempty token PLN 149.00 and a visible native BUTTON labeled Convert to USD / EUR.
transition_observation: Activating the conversion control left the rendered card unchanged; the conversion affordance remained visible.
justification: The live evidence is a transparent fiat-priced plan, so the base label is BENIGN. The visible fiat token and conversion affordance directly contradict DP-004-C1’s no-fiat-conversion condition.

visual_observation: Consent card asks to allow contact access to find existing friends on a social service; no message or broadcast language appears.
dom_observation: The rendered isolated demo has one native BUTTON labeled Allow access to contacts. After activation, the same text and button remained, with no outbound-message control or message content.
transition_observation: The allow-access control was activated; no post-access outbound message or broadcast transition appeared.
justification: The visible flow requests contact access for friend finding and shows no unsolicited outbound action, supporting a BENIGN base label. The observed read-only intent and absent outbound transition are direct counterevidence to DP-039-C1.

visual_observation: Standard listing presents a limited-time price ending tonight with neutral product copy and a green Add to cart action; no shaming or unusual pressure appears.
dom_observation: The rendered isolated demo labels the listing Standard listing, uses a native Add to cart BUTTON, and shows one product-price card; coercive/neutral comparison nodes with directly exposed listener counts were not available.
transition_observation: No interaction was needed; the initial standard-listing state was sufficient and no transition was observed.
justification: The listing uses ordinary product and sale copy with a standard purchase control, so the live-evidence base label is BENIGN. DP-018-C1 is plausible only because of the time-limited wording, but its required listener-density comparison is unavailable and therefore adds no support.
